intro.name: Aria
intro.text: I can't marry a man I don't love, for a crown I never asked for.

intro.name: Aria
intro.text: I slipped out through the old temple passage before anyone noticed I was gone.

intro.name: Aria
intro.text: Whatever's out here, it has to be better than being a princess trapped behind palace walls.

outro.name: Aria
outro.text: A Time Crystal... strange. It felt like it recognized me.

outro.name: Aria
outro.text: I need to keep moving. If they find me, they'll drag me back before I've even begun.

intro.name: Aria
intro.text: My feet are killing me. Just a few minutes by this river, then I'll keep going.

intro.name: Caleb
intro.text: ...You're not who I thought you were.

intro.name: Aria
intro.text: You just pulled me into a river! Who even are you?!

intro.name: Caleb
intro.text: My mistake. I was expecting an assassin, not-

intro.name: Caleb
intro.text: Never mind. Forget you saw me.

intro.name: Aria
intro.text: Wait-! ...Handsome and rude. Exactly what I needed today.

outro.name: Caleb
outro.text: You're still following me.

outro.name: Aria
outro.text: I'm not following you, our paths just keep crossing!

outro.name: Caleb
outro.text: Convenient, for someone heading toward the same crystal I am.

outro.name: Aria
outro.text: You're looking for the Time Crystals too?

outro.name: Caleb
outro.text: I need one to get close to the dragon. I intend to kill it and take what's inside.

outro.name: Aria
outro.text: Kill a dragon? Just like that?

outro.name: Caleb
outro.text: It's not a request for permission, princess.

outro.name: Aria
outro.text: ...How did you know I'm-

outro.name: Caleb
outro.text: Palace boots. And you walk like someone used to being followed, not like someone who's ever had to run.

outro.name: Aria
outro.text: Fine. Since we're apparently going the same way - try not to slow me down.

outro.name: Caleb
outro.text: That's my line.

intro.name: Aria
intro.text: Sand for miles. Remind me why I agreed to travel with the dragon-slayer.

intro.name: Caleb
intro.text: You didn't agree. You just didn't leave.

idris_intro.name: Idris
idris_intro.text: Well, well. The runaway princess and the ghost prince, traveling together. How touching.

idris_intro.name: Caleb
idris_intro.text: Idris. I should have known the Sovereign would send you.

idris_intro.name: Idris
idris_intro.text: He wants the crystal fragment before you reach the dragon. I intend to deliver.

idris_intro.name: Idris
idris_intro.text: Ask your prince. Assuming he lives long enough to tell you.

idris_victory.name: Caleb
idris_victory.text: You're still standing. Don't mistake that for mercy.

idris_victory.name: Idris
idris_victory.text: Careful, prince. Mercy is a hard habit to break once it starts.

idris_victory.name: Idris
idris_victory.text: This isn't over. But maybe it isn't what I thought it was, either.

idris_victory.name: Caleb
idris_victory.text: Someone we'll deal with when the time comes. Keep moving.

outro.name: Aria
outro.text: You know him. Idris.

outro.name: Caleb
outro.text: I know a lot of people I'd rather not.

outro.name: Aria
outro.text: You're not going to tell me anything, are you.

outro.name: Caleb
outro.text: Not yet.

intro.name: Aria
intro.text: It's freezing. And you don't even look cold.

rowan_intro.name: Rowan
rowan_intro.text: Halt. None pass the Ice Court without the Sovereign's word.

rowan_intro.name: Caleb
rowan_intro.text: Rowan. Still guarding a throne that was never his to protect.

rowan_intro.name: Rowan
rowan_intro.text: And you're still pretending you're not royalty, Caleb. It doesn't suit you.

rowan_intro.name: Rowan
rowan_intro.text: If you want through, you'll go through me.

rowan_victory.name: Rowan
rowan_victory.text: ...You've gotten stronger. Or I've gotten careless.

rowan_victory.name: Rowan
rowan_victory.text: The Sovereign promised us all a kingdom worth ruling. All he's given us is orders.

rowan_victory.name: Rowan
rowan_victory.text: Ask me again in the spring whose side I'm on. Go. Before I change my mind.

outro.name: Aria
outro.text: Caleb. Is it true? Are you actually-

outro.name: Caleb
outro.text: I'll tell you everything. In the castle. I promise.

outro.name: Aria
outro.text: You'd better.

intro.name: Aria
intro.text: This is it. Whatever's waiting for us, it's here.

intro.name: Caleb
intro.text: Stay close. This is where it stops being a story and starts being real.

boss_intro.name: The Hollow Sovereign
boss_intro.text: So. The crystal-bearer finally arrives. And she brought my wayward prince with her.

boss_intro.name: Aria
boss_intro.text: Your prince? Caleb, what is he talking about?

boss_intro.name: Caleb
boss_intro.text: He's talking about the throne I walked away from. The one he stole the moment I was gone.

boss_intro.name: The Hollow Sovereign
boss_intro.text: Stole? I merely took what you refused to hold. Give me the crystals, and I'll let the girl live.

boss_intro.name: Caleb
boss_intro.text: Touch her and you'll regret every century you've stolen.

boss_intro.name: The Hollow Sovereign
boss_intro.text: Brave words. Let's see if the Timewyrm agrees.

boss_victory.name: Caleb
boss_victory.text: He isn't. Not yet. Come on - the sanctum's just ahead.

outro.name: The Hollow Sovereign
outro.text: Impossible. You were nothing. A prince who ran from his own crown!

outro.name: Caleb
outro.text: I ran because I refused to become you. That doesn't mean I forgot how to fight.

outro.name: Aria
outro.text: ...He really is a prince. The most dangerous one in every timeline, they said. I thought it was a rumor.

outro.name: The Hollow Sovereign
outro.text: The dragon's crystal is MINE. I have waited centuries for it.

outro.name: Caleb
outro.text: The dragon was never yours to take. Aria - the crystal isn't a weapon. It's the dragon's heart. If he takes it, the dragon dies, and every timeline it holds together dies with it.

outro.name: Aria
outro.text: Then we don't let him take it. We protect it. Together.

outro.name: Caleb
outro.text: ...You feel that too? Aria, that's not just courage. You have power of your own. You always did.

outro.name: Aria
outro.text: I'm not weak. I never was. I was just never allowed to find out.

outro.name: Rowan
outro.text: About time someone put him in his place.

outro.name: Idris
outro.text: Didn't think I'd say this, but... good work, prince. Both of you.

outro.name: Caleb
outro.text: Aria. Whatever happens next - throne, timeline, whatever's left of my old life - I'd rather face it with you than rule it alone.

outro.name: Aria
outro.text: Then don't rule it alone. Rule it with me.

outro.name: Caleb
outro.text: ...I'd like that.
